id.description: Google Drive file id, or the relative path for a local collection

kind.description: photo=captured · design=finished artwork · screenshot=screen capture · diagram=chart or slide · logo=isolated brand mark

medium.description: physical=printed material or a real object · digital=on-screen artwork · na=not applicable. A printed mockup is design + physical.

caption.description: one factual sentence, written by the vision model

has_text.description: the image has text baked into it

text.description: OCR — comes free from Google Drive, costs no tokens

labels.description: raw Google labels; noisy, stored without trust

hash.description: file checksum; this is what makes updates incremental
